note: General angling practice written by this app. NOT regulations, NOT CDFW content, NOT sourced to any official publication. No record may state, imply or summarise a rule; every record cross-links to the gear and bait regulations the app already carries verbatim. Every hook size and every bait name here is the app's own general angling knowledge and is unsourced — that is the honest reason there is no citation field on these records.

tips_disclaimer.headline: Angling tips — not regulations, not CDFW content
tips_disclaimer.body: Written by this app from general angling practice. Nothing here is a rule and nothing here is permission. Gear and bait are restricted on most California waters and the restrictions change by water and by season — read the rules above and the water's own listing before you rig.
tips_disclaimer.no_citation_line: No citation — this is not sourced to any regulation.

hook.style: Offset worm hook (EWG) for soft plastics; trebles as they come on hard baits
hook.note: Hook size is a matter of matching the bait, not a rule.

baits.name: Unscented soft-plastic stick worm, wacky or Texas rigged
Scented or flavoured soft plastics (garlic worms, scented craws)
baits.note: These count as bait rather than as an artificial lure — the definition of a lure excludes anything scented or flavoured, however the scent got there. On a water whose listing names artificial lures only, these do not qualify.

records.technique: Work the edges — points, docks, weed lines and any hard change in the bottom — and slow down as the water cools.

records.why: No tips: the daily and annual bags are both zero, so this is a release fishery with one narrow barbless-hook gear rule. Read § 5.80 before you rig.
must_check: § 5.80 sets the hook and the handling rules, and they are narrower than anything else in fresh water.
A Sturgeon Fishing Report Card is required — § 5.80(f).

On the Sacramento River from Keswick Dam to the Highway 162 Bridge it is unlawful to take any sturgeon at all, January 1 to December 31 — § 5.80(i)(1)(A). The same closure also bars wire leaders, and lamprey or shrimp as bait.

records.why: No tips: the gear rules change river-by-river and date-by-date, so a tip written for one stretch would be wrong on the next. Read the river's own listing first.
must_check: The river's own listing — anadromous gear rules change by stretch and by date.
A report card is required, and it must be filled in as you fish.

records.why: No tips: northern pike is an eradicated species in California — one must be killed immediately and CDFW notified. See § 5.51.
must_check: § 5.51 — a pike must be killed immediately and CDFW notified.
Do not move a live fish between waters for any reason.
